_note: Booking popup + form. See docs/BOOKING.md. mode = preferred mode; the site falls back automatically clinicflow → enquiry → whatsapp when a mode is unavailable (clinic not found on ClinicFlow247, CORS not allowed, API down). It never shows a success the API did not return.

clinicflow._note: apiBaseUrl / clinicSlug / clinicId can be overridden at build time with NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_CLINIC_SLUG, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_CLINIC_ID. clinicId is optional: it is looked up from the slug.

popup._note: Auto-opens once per browsing session after delaySeconds, never on page load, never on excludedPaths. On mobile it is a full-height sheet (Google penalises intrusive mobile interstitials — keep it delayed and once-only).

consent.en: I agree to be contacted about this appointment by WhatsApp, SMS, call or email.
consent.te: ఈ అపాయింట్‌మెంట్ గురించి వాట్సాప్, SMS, కాల్ లేదా ఈమెయిల్ ద్వారా నన్ను సంప్రదించడానికి నేను అంగీకరిస్తున్నాను.

note.en: For severe pain or swelling, please call the clinic.
note.te: తీవ్రమైన నొప్పి లేదా వాపు ఉంటే దయచేసి క్లినిక్‌కు కాల్ చేయండి.
